scope: Pre-use source review and non-secret local validation of the private fixed-production M01 database runner

localValidation.environment: Existing owned local Everyone PostgreSQL 17, not production
localValidation.method: Extracted function declarations from the actual runner AST into an isolated test process; the runner body and production DPAPI path were not executed. Native integration cases used only the existing local endpoint and standard local test credential; fake cases replaced the native function in the test process only.

checks.name: Actual native SELECT JSON object shape
Actual native dry-run flat JSON contract on up-to-date local database
Exact seven pending migration plan accepted
Complete external review gate fixture accepted
Receipt secret-content marker rejected before write

actualNativeIntegration.contractBoundary: The native local dry run found zero pending migrations because that local database already held the baseline. The exact-seven pending success case is a separate non-secret fake-output guard test, supported by the pinned CLI implementation; it is not presented as a local seven-migration apply or production receipt.

embeddedSelectValidation.transport: Local Docker psql, ON_ERROR_STOP=1, against owned Everyone PostgreSQL 17
embeddedSelectValidation.boundary: Local SQL syntax and expected catalogue shape do not prove production schema, advisors, migration parity or restricted-role authentication.

defectsCaughtBeforeProductionCredentialU.issue: Unary-comma wrapping retained a nested array around parsed rows and snapshot arrays, so the snapshot property or empty/seven-row counts could be misread.
defectsCaughtBeforeProductionCredentialU.correction: Both JSON and snapshot-return layers now unwrap through normal PowerShell pipeline enumeration.
defectsCaughtBeforeProductionCredentialU.validation: Actual native and fake object/empty-array/multiple-row cases all passed before production handoff use.

defectsCaughtBeforeProductionCredentialU.issue: Final serialized receipt guard originally ran after plaintext clearing.
defectsCaughtBeforeProductionCredentialU.correction: The secret-content guard now runs before final plaintext clearing; a non-secret marker regression rejects the write.

defectsCaughtBeforeProductionCredentialU.issue: Preflight cron command text and arbitrary function configuration values were broader than required non-secret metadata.
defectsCaughtBeforeProductionCredentialU.correction: Cron output contains only reviewed-command equality flags; function configuration output contains only the expected-empty-search-path flag.

defectsCaughtBeforeProductionCredentialU.issue: Automatic reconciliation could otherwise launch another credential-bearing child after an unconfirmed owned-process cleanup.
defectsCaughtBeforeProductionCredentialU.correction: Cleanup failure suppresses automatic reconciliation and records a manual readback requirement.

independentReviewAndExecutionGates.rootReportedIndependentSourceReview: PASS before actual production preflight and dry run; separate from this author's implementation and local validation
pushRequires: Existing recorded exact-packet owner authorization, hashed into the root review gate
Verified fixed production dashboard target, backup/recovery disposition and Git automation controls
Exact seven-file dry run with no seeds or roles files and matching migration seals
Root-written review gate binding runner hash, migration-seal digest, preflight fingerprint and actual dry-run-plan file hash
Fresh pre-push read-only state and pending-plan recheck
Exclusive push-attempt sentinel written and dry-run plan consumed before one push launch
independentReviewAndExecutionGates.ambiguousOrFailedWrite: Read actual history/schema before any further write; the attempt sentinel blocks replay. No reset, fabricated history, automatic retry, fixture import or grant expansion.
independentReviewAndExecutionGates.postWriteAcceptance: Production catalogue, advisors, types, API/provider settings and restricted-role receipts are separately required; native push success alone does not close M01.
independentReviewAndExecutionGates.credentialCleanup: Each owned native child must exit and lose its password environment. Root removes the retained encrypted prod administrator handoff after the approved DB batch or blocking stop; a child cannot clear a separately configured parent process.

authorBoundaries.productionOperationsOwnedBy: Root agent; actual production results must be read from its separate execution receipts
